definitions.short: Ur , a place in Chaldaea; also an Israelite
definitions.full: H218. Uwr II. אוּר proper name, masculine ( flame ) father of one of David's heroes 1Chr 11:35 (III. אוּר proper name, of a location see below) III. אור proper name, of a location Ur (Babylonian Uru; seat of moon-god worship; hence Eupolemos in Euseb Praep.Ev.ix. 17 says Καμαρίνῃ ἥν τινας λέγειν πόλιν Οὐρίην ), ancient city in Southern Babylonia; OT always כַּשְׂדִּים אור i.e. Ur of the Kasdim (Chaldeans) see כַּשְׂדִּים below כשׂד ; home of Terah, Abram's father, & A.'s point of departure for Mesopotamia & Canaan Gen 11:28 ; 15:7 (both J), & hence Neh 9:7 ; also Gen 11:31 (P); — modern Muqayyar , south of Euphrates, approximately 150 miles southeast of Babylon; see KG 94f Dl Pa 226 f COT on 11:28 . אֲוֵרוֺת see אֻרְיָה below I. ארה . אֲוַרְנָה see אֲרַוְנָה
